# Memo

> Free skill for storing and finding discussion summaries across ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, on supported computers, phones and tablets. Records live in the user's Google Drive as Google Docs. The same accessible folder and required platform tools are needed.

## Documentation
- [English documentation](https://pauline-zhang-star.github.io/Memo/): What Memo does, save/retrieve commands, platform-specific manual setup, permissions and troubleshooting.
- [中文说明](https://pauline-zhang-star.github.io/Memo/zh/): 产品定义、保存与检索、三平台手动安装、Drive 权限和问题排查。
- [English text reference](https://pauline-zhang-star.github.io/Memo/reference.md): Same project facts in Markdown.
- [中文纯文本说明](https://pauline-zhang-star.github.io/Memo/zh/reference.md): 相同事实的 Markdown 版本。
- [Project source](https://github.com/pauline-zhang-star/Memo): Public skill instructions; excludes the paid installer and personal configuration.

## Optional installer
Memo Setup is a separate paid convenience tool for supported Macs, not a requirement for using the free skill. No installer binary or purchase link is published here yet.
